preconditions.description: The number of levels in the tree is between 1 and 7000.
The number of operations is between 1 and 7000.
The level for the first type of operation is between 1 and n.
The range of positions for the first type of operation is within the count of vertices on level t.
The value to be added to sets is between 1 and 10^6.
The level for the second type of operation is between 1 and n.
The position for the second type of operation is within the count of vertices on level t.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of integers
postconditions.description: The output consists of integers corresponding to the results of the second type operations.
